name: Jezero Crater repeat-coverage assessment
source: Published literature and PDS product metadata

coordinate_reference_system.name: Product-specific Mars map projection
coordinate_reference_system.status: No site-specific product stack has been assembled.

license: Not applicable to this assessment record; source products retain their own licenses
limitations: This is not a curated multitemporal dune dataset and contains no pixels or labels.
Repeat HiRISE coverage exists, but interior dune migration at Jezero is reported to be limited.
Published observations describe a small number of dunes in the inlet channel and no detected ripple movement over some one-year and four-year pairs.
Rates measured at Hargraves, Coprates or other sites must not be transferred to Jezero.
A future Jezero study must resolve product IDs, dates, geometry, quality and a verified metre-per-pixel scale.

published_context.repeat_coverage_context: About 44 HiRISE images over roughly ten years have been reported for Jezero in conference literature.
published_context.interior_dune_context: Interior dune migration is reported as limited; seven dunes were noted in the inlet channel.
published_context.ripple_context: No ripple movement was detected in some one-year and four-year comparisons.
published_context.related_regional_study_note: Sahu et al. report Pasteur crater ripple-crest rates of 0.29-1.18 m per Earth year; these are not Jezero measurements.

notes: Assessment record only. It exists to prevent unsupported transfer of migration rates to Jezero and to define the checks required before a dedicated study.
